lead: Taylor Swift is best known as an American singer-songwriter, born on 13 December 1989 in West Reading.
As of 2026, she is 36 years old, and her birth date places her under the Sagittarius sign.
She has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Dick Clark Award for Excellence and MTV Video Music Award for Best Female Video.
The sections that follow break down Taylor Swift's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Taylor Swift — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Taylor Swift was born on 13 December 1989 in West Reading, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Taylor Alison Swift at birth and is publicly known as Taylor Swift.
Public records name her father, Scott Swift and her mother, Andrea Finlay. She is a sibling of Austin Swift.
She studied at Hendersonville High School and Wyomissing Area Junior/Senior High School.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Taylor Swift — Career and Professional Work
paras: Taylor Swift works primarily as a singer-songwriter, singer and lyricist.
She performs on banjo, guitar, piano and ukulele.
She has taken part in Ice Bucket Challenge.
